note: THE signature fault — remove or replace the cap.

name: Xbox 360 (Fat)
note: Reflow is temporary — walk away as a flip.

name: Xbox 360 Slim / S
note: Clean + repaste; no RROD epidemic on Slim.

name: Xbox Series S
note: Parts-pairing live — donor-board math doesn't work.

note: Parts-pairing live — donor-board math doesn't work.

note: Cap replacement is a semi-reliable fix.

name: PS3 (Fat)
note: DO NOT part out — worth more whole.

name: PS4 (original)
note: Bread-and-butter rework, very common. VRAM donor chip: Samsung K4G41325FC-HC03.

name: PS4 (original)
note: Blue Light of Death is often PSU or HDMI handshake.

name: PS5 (disc)
note: Donor needs pairing. Digital editions exempt.

name: PS5 Digital
note: No disc drive to deal with.

name: PS5 Pro
note: Parts scarce/expensive, barely in the repair channel — any risk is expensive.

name: Xbox 360 Wireless Controller
note: Not worth it on a cheap pad.

name: Xbox Series X|S Wireless Controller
note: USB-C connector job is part of the rep.

name: DualShock 4 (v1)
note: The headline DS4 fault — hall/TMR mod exit.

name: DualSense (PS5)
note: Endemic — class-action territory. TMR is the premium exit label.

name: DualSense (PS5)
fault: Triggers dead at the IC / dead pad

name: DualSense Edge
note: Fix is often trivial — modules by design; hall = drop-in swap.

name: DualSense Edge
note: High resale ceiling can still justify board work.

name: Aspire 5 (A515-54, 2019)
note: Not on low-value units. Verify exact A515 suffix — many sub-variants.

name: Inspiron 15 3000 (3501, 2020)
note: Not on low-value units. Model code generic — verify exact suffix.

name: Pavilion 15 (2019)
note: Not on low-value units. No stable model code — verify exact SKU.

name: IdeaPad 3 15 (2020)
note: Not on low-value units. Many sub-variants — verify suffix.

name: XPS 15 (9560, 2017)
note: Classic intake — endemic across the XPS 15 line.

name: ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 6 (2018)
note: NOT drained like classic ThinkPads — spills are riskier here.

name: MacBook Pro 13" (Function Keys, 2016-2017)
note: A1708 = Late-2016 and Mid-2017; RAM soldered.

name: MacBook Pro 13" (Touch Bar, 2016-2017)
note: Touch Bar/Touch ID complicates board work.

name: MacBook Air 13" Retina (Late 2018)
note: Endemic; keyboard tied into topcase — expensive.

name: MacBook Air 13" Retina (2019)
note: Same A1932 case as 2018; adds True Tone.

name: MacBook Pro 15" (Touch Bar, 2018-2019)
note: dGPU adds thermal/board failure modes. A1990 = Mid-2018 + 2019.

name: MacBook Pro 16" (Intel, 2019)
note: Scissor keyboard returns — solid platform otherwise.

name: MacBook Air 13" Retina (Intel, 2020)
cause: USB-C charge port / board, charge IC
note: Scissor keyboard — reliable. Short-lived model (replaced by M1 same year).

name: MacBook Air (M1, 2020)
note: Huge resale volume; scissor keyboard reliable.

name: MacBook Pro 13" (M1, 2020)
note: High volume; last 13" with Touch Bar.

name: MacBook Pro 14" (M1 Pro / M1 Max, 2021)
note: Panel pricey — not on low-value units.
